style.backgroundSystem: mustard studio backdrop #F2A93B for hero and scene shots, warm off-white #FAF7F0 for infographic and trust shots, with a subtle thin grid-line graphic overlay allowed on hero backgrounds
style.iconSystem: thin-line circle icons and small solid accent dots, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bold warm studio lighting, strong directional key from the upper left, crisp cast shadows on the floor, controlled highlight on denim texture
style.lockText: consistent street-fashion menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm studio background #F2A93B, off-white #FAF7F0, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one deep-orange accent #E8842C; bold warm studio lighting with a strong directional key from the upper left and crisp cast shadows on the floor; bold condensed sans-serif headlines in charcoal on light panels and white on dark panels; consistent rounded rectangular info chips, thin-line circle icons and thin bordered feature cards; clean street-style photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable on-model presentation of the lower-body garment with the jeans always clearly readable and the framing kept clean and balanced; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: on-model presentation of the lower-body garment, stable front 3/4 hero angle, jeans always clearly readable, model face cropped or generic
style.surfaceSystem: seamless studio floor and matte warm board, hard-edged cast shadows as a graphic element
style.typography: bold condensed sans-serif headlines, charcoal #2D2D2D on light and #FFFFFF on dark panels
